mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_job( analysis_job_id, query_instance_id, session_id, turn_id, tool_call_id, status, analysis_prompt, keyword_type, top_n, model_provider, model_name, sample_count, error_message ) VALUES( #{analysisJobId}, #{queryInstanceId}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{toolCallId}, #{status}, #{analysisPrompt}, #{keywordType}, #{topN}, #{modelProvider}, #{modelName}, #{sampleCount}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_job SET status = #{status}, sample_count = #{sampleCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE analysis_job_id = #{analysisJobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_result( analysis_job_id, keywords_json, topics_json, findings_summary, evidence_cases_json, raw_llm_output, structured_json ) VALUES( #{analysisJobId}, #{keywordsJson}, #{topicsJson}, #{findingsSummary}, #{evidenceCasesJson}, #{rawLlmOutput}, #{structuredJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE keywords_json = VALUES(keywords_json), topics_json = VALUES(topics_json), findings_summary = VALUES(findings_summary), evidence_cases_json = VALUES(evidence_cases_json), raw_llm_output = VALUES(raw_llm_output), structured_json = VALUES(structured_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
